concepts.gloss_en: His (blessed) glory was revealed — the revelation (hitgalut) of God's glory

members.note: same verb נתגלה; adds honorific יתברך + trailing space; same lm2:71 discussion of revelation of glory

concepts.gloss_en: His glory was revealed AND magnified — compound action adding נתגדל (magnification) to the revelation

members.note: adds נתגדל (was magnified) as a second verbal head; distinct action-phrase from bare נתגלה, kept separate per under-merge preference though same lm2:71 context

concepts.gloss_en: His glory was increased and magnified — different verbal heads (נתרבה/נתגדל, not נתגלה) and different Torah (lm2:8)

members.note: verbs נתרבה ונתגדל (increased/magnified) ≠ נתגלה (revealed); separate Torah lm2:8; distinct action about the glory

notes: All forms are action-phrases predicated of כבודו יתברך; split by verbal head per rule 4 (an action about X is not X, and different actions are different concepts). נתגלה-cluster (lm2:71) merged across space/יתברך orthographic-honorific variants; נתגלה ונתגדל and נתרבה ונתגדל kept separate.
